segments.text: A self-issued request is harder to notice than one from a manager. When your boss hands you a solution, it is at least visibly someone else's answer. When you hand it to yourself, it feels like something you already figured out. "I should be better at using AI at work" is one of these. So is "I need to get organized," and "we should have a better process for this."
